SUMMARY Management reported that second quarter performance exceeded internal expectations, which led to a 300 million increase in full-year revenue guidance for AbbVie Inc. ( ABBV -1.81% ) . The company announced the acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, which the CFO stated will contribute approximately $0.14 of dilution to the 2026 adjusted EPS outlook. Growth was concentrated in the immunology and neuroscience segments, which helped mitigate the impact of biosimilar competition for HUMIRA and the pricing pressures affecting IMBRUVICA. The company also secured several regulatory milestones, including European approvals for the oral migraine treatment QLIPTA and the fast-acting aesthetics toxin Bowie. CEO Michael indicated the Apogee acquisition represents an opportunity to "bolster AbbVie's leading immunology portfolio" and support performance goals through the 2030s. Management projected collective peak sales for oral CGRPs to exceed $5 billion, following the expanded European approval of QLIPTA for acute migraine treatment. CSO Thakkar noted that SKYRIZI subcutaneous induction for Crohn’s disease demonstrated endoscopic response rates "45 points higher in patients who had not previously experienced advanced therapy." The company expects its Parkinson’s disease portfolio, including the anticipated launch of tevapadon, to reach collective peak sales of more than $5 billion. CFO Reents stated the company remains committed to achieving a net leverage ratio of 2 times within two to three years following the close of the Apogee transaction. Management reported that SKYRIZI has achieved market share leadership in more than 30 countries, capturing new patient starts at a rate fourfold higher than competitors in the U.S. psoriasis market. CSO Thakkar highlighted that the blood-brain barrier crossing antibody ABBV-1.76 thousand demonstrated cerebrospinal fluid penetration over 1%, which is severalfold higher than standard antibodies. INDUSTRY GLOSSARY ADC : Antibody-drug conjugate; a class of biopharmaceutical drugs designed as a targeted therapy for treating cancer. IBD : Inflammatory bowel disease; a group of inflammatory conditions of the colon and small intestine. CGRP : Calcitonin gene-related peptide; a protein involved in migraine pathophysiology that is targeted by certain migraine medications. IRA : Inflation Reduction Act; U.S. legislation that includes provisions for government negotiation of drug prices. CLL : Chronic lymphocytic leukemia; a type of cancer of the blood and bone marrow. BPDCN : Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; an ultra-rare and aggressive form of blood cancer. HS : Hidradenitis suppurativa; a chronic inflammatory skin condition.
